title: Morning rush in Mississauga: every bus and train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Mississauga, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus and train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Mississauga city limits are faded and not counted.

Busiest moment of the morning: 328 vehicles at 8:06 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
